description: Find local businesses with address, rating, reviews and place ID. Not general web pages (use google_search). Required: query. Optional: location.

language.description: Two-letter language code for place results.

location.description: Place to centre the search on, for example "Rome, Italy". Without it, a place named in the query ("pizza in Rome") is used.

results.description: Maximum number of places to return.

name: google_maps_places
title: Google Maps Places
